overview: Recurring operational control, incident response, trend reporting, changes and service improvement through an agreed rota. The scope is built around compute and storage inventories, backup policy and recovery objectives, producing capacity and recovery blueprint with completed isolated restore. A customer-named infrastructure lead approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is RPO, RTO and dependency drills.
